newsitem.title: GERMANY: Car accident starts unlucky run for German thief.
newsitem.headline: Car accident starts unlucky run for German thief.

text.p: A German thief's luck ran out on Friday the 13th when police discovered more than 10,000 marks ($6,600) worth of stolen goods in the boot of his car after he caused a four-car accident.

Police said the 23-year-old man was first detained on Friday by officers investigating the accident on a highway about 120 km (75 miles) north of Frankfurt for driving a stolen vehicle and not having a proper licence.

During a search of the car, police later discovered 41,400 cigarettes without customs stamps, several pairs of sunglasses and boxes of luxury cosmetics. A search of the man's apartment revealed more stolen items, police added.
Some of the goods were believed to have been stolen during recent robberies at duty-free shops at Frankfurt Airport. ($1=1.5126 Mark)
